legacy_signup.description: A private imported marketing signup, including original consent and delivery evidence; import sends no message.

legacy_opt_out.description: The digest of an existing unsubscribe capability, preserving suppression without sending mail.

mail_opt_out.description: The customer opted out of commercial messages.

book_legacy.description: The original imported book or order record, retained privately for reconciliation. It never authorizes payment or fulfillment.

legacy_order.description: A migrated order's capability digest and retained shipping format. Reading a legacy status never schedules fulfillment.
